title: Ɛnne a efi Kwae a Ɛrehyew no Mu
intro: Bue onipa bi a emu dɔ a n’akwantu no fii ase wɔ anwonwakwan so hyia mu na ne nkrabea ne nnipa a wɔahyɛ wɔn so ahofadi a wɔde bɛma no abɔ mu no mu. Wɔpaw saa onipa yi maa adwuma kɛse bi, na ohyiaa nsɛnnennen akɛse denam ɔsoro mmoa so.
clues: Wɔwoo me kɔɔ nhyɛso kɛse bere mu, baabi a na wɔrekunkum me nkurɔfo nkokoaa.
Na me mmofraase asetra hwehwɛ sɛ m’awofo de me too asubɔnten bi mu, nanso wohuu me na wɔtetee me wɔ me nkurɔfo nhyɛsofo no fie ankasa mu.
Bere bi miguan fii kurow bi mu bere a manhyɛ da ama ankorankoro bi awu bere a na akasakasa bi rekɔ so no.
Me nsa kaa ɔsoro nkrasɛm ne anwonwade poma wɔ beae kronkron bi, faako a wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menhyia sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi.
Wɔpaw me nuabarima sɛ ɔboafo maa me wɔ m’asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no mu, esiane akwanside bi a na wosusuw sɛ ɛwɔ me kasa mu nti.
Midii me nkurɔfo anim twaa po a emu apaapae, na miguan fii asraafo atirimɔdenfo akyidi no ho.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔpɛ a ɛkɔɔ so mfe pii a wogyinaa ano
Farao ne n’akɔmfoɔ a ɔne wɔn bɛhyia
Wɔtow no gu fononoo a ogya wom mu
Nnipa a wɔwɔ Thamud no sɛe
trial.answer: Farao ne n’akɔmfoɔ a ɔne wɔn bɛhyia

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Nsuyiri kɛse no kataa asase no so
Farao ne n’asraafo no nsu faa wɔn
Kurow no afasu bubui esiane nteɛm bi nti
outcome.answer: Farao ne n’asraafo no nsu faa wɔn

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
